issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

name.description: The unique and required name of this instance.

maxRetries.description: Maximum number of times the operation will be retried (not including the initial try).

initialSleepMillis.description: Sleep time for first retry (plus randomization). If <= 0 the default will be used.

exponent.description:
The exponent to multiply the prior wait time in generating the next. This should be > 1.0 and probably less than
3.0. Note that 2.0 will double the maximum possible wait each time. If <= 1 the default will be used.

maxSleepMillis.description: Maximum wait time allowed for each retry. If <= 0 the default will be used.

maxTotalMillis.description: Maximum wait time allowed for all retry waits

minSleepMillis.description: The minimum sleep time guaranteed each iteration.

retryOnEmptyResult.description: If set to true, it will retry when result is empty.

jitter.description: Determines the algorithm used to calculate jitter. See {@link ExponentialBackoff.Jitter}.

retryAllErrors.description:
If true, all errors will be retried. If false, only retryable errors {@link Retry#shouldRetryLogic}
will be retried.

trace.description:
If true, the retry logic will report each retry attempt in root `C3.action()`'s `#customContext` with key as
`retry-trace`.

url.description: Url by which to connect to the REST endpoint.

auth.description: Secret auth token to use to authenticate to the REST endpoint

createPool.description: If true a ConnectionPool will be created for every maxConn clients

maxConn.description:
Maximum Connections.
    the maximum number of concurrent connections to a given endpoint

retries.description:
Number of attempts to send a request if there is a retryable error. Note the the error can be an exception thrown
by the CloseableHttpClient.execute() (like org.apache.http.NoHttpResponseException), or an http error (code >= 400
&& code < 600) as defined by the {@link Rest.retryHttpCodes}

Default is 1

retryBaseSleep.description:
Base value in seconds to start sleeping during retries. A geometric backoff will be done based on this value
(retryBaseSleep * retryCount)

Default is 10 seconds

retryHttpCodes.description:
Http codes that will be used for retry. If apiRetryErrors are specified both conditions need to be met for retry to
be done (httpRetryCodes && apiRetryErrors).

retryApiErrors.description:
Retry on any of these API specific error strings. The check will look for the given string in the error returned,
in the response body if there is one, otherwise in the response status line.

failOnRedirectResponse.description:
Treat a 3xx redirect response as an error (as done with 4xx/5xx responses). Useful in cases where redirection is
known to indicate unavailability or incorrect routing.

timeout.description: Override the timeout(in seconds). Default is 60s

oauth2Config.description:
OAuth2.0 configuration
Instead of using the auth token, the OAuth2.0 token will be used to authenticate to the REST endpoint.
The OAuth2.0 token will be generated using the client credentials and signed with the private key.
By default token based auth is selected if oauth2Config is empty

title: Configurations to be used by the REST Engine (e.g. auth, url...).
name: RestConfig
